_comment: Lint ratchet baseline. Checked by scripts/lint-ratchet.mjs from the CI
`lint` job: the count may fall, never rise. See CI-LINT-PLAN.md.
`fatals` is tracked separately because a fatal is a PARSE failure, not a
rule finding — the file was never linted at all. The backend's 120 are
its test files: tsconfig.json excludes src/**/__tests__/** and
src/**/*.test.ts, so the type-aware parser has no project for them.
Plan Phase 4 fixes that, and the backend count is EXPECTED to rise when
it does. Re-baseline deliberately (--update) rather than calling it a
To lower it after real cleanup:
cd backend && npm run -s lint:json | node ../scripts/lint-ratchet.mjs backend --update
